name: Floot
description: Build and host full-stack apps using your own Claude subscription. No AI build credits required. Floot MCP Server exposes the entire platform as native Claude tool calls: create a project, write code, provision a database, enable auth, manage file storage, and deploy, all from a single conversation. Your Claude subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out. Works with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Floot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Floot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.floot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Floot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Floot lists 46 MCP tools, including add_dependency, apply_patch, cancel_request, copy_file, create_project, delete_file, edit_file, execute_sql, fetch, generate_image, get_current_context, and get_guide.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Floot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Floot in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Floot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Floot is developed by Floot. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
